_about: Factions: groups of unhappy players who act together (relationship overhaul, factions phase; Factions.gd). A player stands with a group when his opinion of his coach is under join_line and his grievance fits the kind: how far under, times his temperament's 'faction' lever, must reach join_need. A group forms when min_members stand together and none of that kind is already there; it falls apart when fewer than min_members are left. Pressure rises each round by per_member for every member and the council's sway (Factions.council_sway), and falls by ease when a round passes with nobody newly aggrieved. At demand_at the group asks for something (a card for your club; a rival's coach answers by his own standing); at ultimatum_at it gives its final word, and after ultimatum_rounds unanswered it breaks: its leader asks to be traded at season's end. Effects reach the game only through morale (each member's settling point, morale_shift by state) and Togetherness. Sizes are proposals: balance is the director's call.

fringe.label: The fringe players
fringe.who: Players left out of the side, who feel they are not getting a fair go.
fringe.demand: a fair go at selection, with one of them picked next week

broken_word.label: Players who have lost faith in your word
broken_word.group_word: a group of players who say you broke your word
broken_word.who: Players who saw you break a promise, to them or to a teammate.
broken_word.demand: you to front the group and own it

senior.label: Senior players
senior.who: Experienced players who no longer rate how you run the club.
senior.demand: a say in how the side is picked and how it plays
